title: My Heart Exults in the Lord

request.style: English, ancient Middle Eastern song of thanksgiving, a woman's voice alone over an oud drone, then frame drums and women's voices join, Maqam Hijaz, slow then rising, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
My heart exults in the Lord
My strength is lifted up in the Lord
There is none holy like the Lord
There is none besides you

[Chorus]
The Lord brings low and he lifts up
He raises the poor from the dust
He lifts the needy from the ash heap
To sit with princes

[Verse]
The bows of the mighty are broken
The feeble are clothed with strength
The barren has borne seven
The Lord kills and brings to life

[Chorus]
The Lord brings low and he lifts up
He raises the poor from the dust
He lifts the needy from the ash heap
To sit with princes
